limitations: Unity behavior is executed on Windows in 6000.6.2f1. The Unity 2021 result is compiler-only; actual older-editor execution remains deferred by maintainer instruction.

Bounds apply per body and parsed document, not total process memory, retained queue arguments, concurrent uploads or slow senders. Original MCP/JSON string allocations and native buffering remain separate.
Asset and integration file readers retain the existing MiniJson.Deserialize implementation; only HTTP request argument parsing changes.
Initial guarded-submission fixture used wall-clock time and was corrected to the existing monotonic session clock; this was not a product defect.

The chunked fixture now receives the rejection while uploading. Waiting until every write finishes can lose the response during early socket closure. It sends 33554433 entity bytes from a larger prepared Unicode buffer.

Released-server oversized uploads can surface a connection failure instead of HTTP 413 and may use their existing retry policy. The current server preflight avoids uploading the rejected envelope; all four runs verify zero snippet executions for rejected input.
The initial 100-level baseline safely reproduced missing depth validation; no deliberate stack-overflow or editor-crash payload was executed.
